summary: Milestone 3 replaces the rejected chamber with the approved sparse B3 fortress hall in the live game. Five separate Meshy jobs supply tabletop and room lanterns, aged column, chest and brazier; Blender preserves UV/PBR maps, grounds/simplifies assets and links them into an editable room. Static practical lighting, map/vista source pixels, existing mat/frame/card projection retained. Shared routing is only native-check tooling and the launcher Python selection fix; no rules/state/network/input behavior changed. PR #124 run.sh overlap inspected: existing catalogue validation retained.
validation: C# build 0 warnings/errors; Godot import passes. Seven final native Mac camera/input cases pass (normal, battle, max zoom, ultrawide, compact, attachments, reduced motion); visible projection error <=0.000281px. Earlier transient battle/whole-board diagnostic failures and their limits are documented in validation-b3.json. Final pane containment rechecked in native composition/lantern captures and normal Play Latest launch under Finder-style PATH. All 11 gallery captures inspected. Blender reopens with all five relative asset libraries; original mat/frame hashes unchanged. A short forced draw/sync capture smoke passes; no sustained FPS claim. Five Meshy tasks consumed 150 credits; reported balance 1655.
remaining: Pause at Alfredo's requested static room/prop review milestone. Draft PR #234 remains unmerged. The implementation is not yet a 1:1 match: timber finish, fixture finish, distant vista detail and light softness/distribution need further visual refinement and acceptance. New room animation is deferred as requested. Native Windows, sustained gameplay profiling and final human visual acceptance remain open. Local playable launcher and source/native gallery are available; board token unavailable, GitHub coordination used.
